title: Armstrong and the Faith Marable riverboat band
summary: Ridgley says Armstrong jobbed with them young, then lists the Marable riverboat band and the St. Louis trip.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: Now we are... Peter Ron never was a member of our band. Peter Booker was a member of our band. He played violin. Yeah. But at this time they make this picture. Peter Ron was a member of our band at that time. He never was. Now you're showing the name of your son of the cornet players? Oh yes. What do you mean? Louis Armstrong. Mark Carey. When did you work with Armstrong? Just... never was a member. But he jobbed around with us in Southern Standard Place at times. He was young. He was very young. He hadn't stopped playing in no bands out yet. I think one time I saw a picture taken on one of the river boats where you were playing with Faith Marable. Did you play with him and Armstrong was in that band? Yeah. We were together. The first year that Armstrong played with Faith, we were together. Louis Armstrong, William Ridgely, George Foster, Joe Howard, Baby Dot. John, what's the guy in California now?
St. Sarah in the band, on the band, John?
Yes, St. Sarah. John the saxophonist, but he's in California. This is David John.
He was playing another for him at that time. John Porter playing bass violin. John Porter played... Bass tubo, you know.
He played tubo, I didn't know he was in front of me.

Yeah, he played bass violin before he got on. He was with us when we went to St. Louis on the first year, but I don't remember when I went there. It was pretty good about 18, 19. Well, that's when Louis, we were all together and he got his first start. But, well, he struck with the boat. But I came back to New Orleans and I went to the Southern Standard and the Savoy River Garden. We were working there together.
